choice.basis: The 'Monthly Grid Energy Use (kWh)' chart shows May's usage is near zero (well below the 10,000 kWh grid line), which is a severe drop compared to all other months (ranging from ~17,500 kWh in Jun to 40,000 kWh in Jan). This magnitude of deviation qualifies as a critical anomaly rather than standard low usage.
choice.option_label: Escalate May to critical low-usage anomaly review
